update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Probe interval in seconds. It must be long enough for the configured timeout and retry budget.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds for a configured job whose initial S3 check failed. Zero disables retries.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Absolute HTTP(S) base endpoint of the S3-compatible service, without a path, query, or credentials.

region.title: Region
region.description: S3 signing region, for example us-east-1.

bucket.title: Dedicated probe bucket
bucket.description: Unversioned bucket reserved for this probe. Bucket versioning must be disabled and the bucket must not contain unrelated data.

prefix.title: Probe prefix
prefix.description: Dedicated key prefix, ending with a slash and used only by this collector.

access_key_id.title: Access key ID
access_key_id.description: Static S3 access key ID. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

secret_access_key.title: Secret access key
secret_access_key.description: Static S3 secret access key. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

path_style.title: Path-style addressing
path_style.description: Place the bucket in the URL path. This is the normal choice for Ceph RGW and many S3-compatible endpoints.

max_retries.title: Maximum retries
max_retries.description: Additional attempts allowed per S3 operation. Zero sends one attempt; the maximum is two.

latency_threshold_ms.title: Latency objective
latency_threshold_ms.description: Successful stage duration in milliseconds that raises the silent latency alert. Zero disables the policy.

timeout.title: HTTP timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for one HTTP attempt.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject endpoint redirects so signed requests cannot be resent to an unconfigured origin.

vnode.title: Vnode
vnode.description: Associate this data collection job with a configured Virtual Node.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: HTTP proxy URL. An empty value uses the standard proxy environment variables.

force_http2.title: Force HTTP/2
force_http2.description: Force HTTP/2, including h2c over plain TCP.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. This is insecure.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a client certificate.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to a client private key.
